column1: # Kinwarn (kinwarn.com/washington). National Weather Service warnings via the Iowa Environmental Mesonet through 2026-10-19; tornadoes from the Storm Prediction Center (1950-2025) and NWS Storm Events through 2026-06-30. Counties and the state: warnings that listed the county. Cities: warnings whose outline covered the city center point set by the Census Bureau; population: Census 2025 estimate (unincorporated communities: GeoNames). WEA columns: warnings that set off Wireless Emergency Alerts on phones in the warned area (tornado; severe thunderstorm tagged destructive; flash flood tagged considerable or catastrophic
column2: at issue or in an update whose outline covered the city center or touched the county). Winter columns (July 1 to June 30 winters): winter storm
column5: lake effect snow and snow squall warnings; extreme cold warnings including wind chill warnings; cities: the forecast zones holding the center point (snow squall: the outline)
column6: counties: zones covering at least a tenth of the county (snow squall: warnings that listed the county). Heat columns (calendar years): extreme heat warnings including excessive heat warnings
column8: matched the same way. Wildfire columns: National Interagency Fire Center wildfires (not prescribed burns) that started within 50 km of the center
column9: acres for the whole fire. AQI column: days the county's highest EPA monitor reading was above 100 (cities: their county; blank = no monitor). Storm columns: storms that brought a hurricane
column10: tropical storm or storm surge warning (each storm once per warning type
column11: even when two NWS offices warned the place; storm surge warnings since 2017); high wind warnings; both by forecast zone
column12: matched like the heat columns. Flood columns: river (FL) and areal (FA) flood warnings
